dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Don't you know? It's Genius Invokation TCG, the greatest craze in all of Sumeru, maybe even in all of Teyvat!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: The varied decks, the unpredictable turns... It is all so fascinating.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: That's how all my vacation was just somehow spent playing cards, or studying how to play.
